overrides.title: \bEVO\s+RGB\b
overrides.note: Lian Li O11 Dynamic EVO RGB (455.7 mm GPU, 167 mm cooler per Lian Li's own page). normalize_case drops the word RGB, so the EVO RGB shares the model key of the older plain O11 Dynamic EVO (426 mm), and makers/lianli.py matched the plain EVO page to it; the safer-value rule then kept 426. Skroutz/Shopflix write it 'O11D EVO RGB' (second key). Only listings whose title says 'EVO RGB' are set, so a plain EVO listing keeps its own value. Remove once the case normalizer keeps RGB in this model's name (or lianli.py reaches the o11d-evo-rgb page itself).
